correctness.rationale: The primary source states that a monic generator of a length-\(n\) \(\lambda\)-constacyclic code must divide \(x^n-\lambda\). For the printed first Table 2 row, exact arithmetic in \(\mathbb F_4[x]\) gives remainder \(1+\omega^2x+\omega x^3\) for the natural coefficient order and a different nonzero remainder for the reverse order. The auxiliary six-shift span is independently exhaustive over all \(4^6\) messages and has distance \(3\) and Hermitian hull dimension \(0\).

value.rationale: The disputed row is presented as an optimal constacyclic code and is used to advertise an almost-EAQMDS construction. Failure of the generator's defining divisibility condition invalidates that row as printed before any subtle hull computation is reached. The correction materially affects a named quantum-code output, while the exhaustive shift-span check supplies a reproducible diagnostic showing that the displayed coefficients also miss the claimed distance and hull under the most direct linear interpretation.
